description: Watches the health of the machine it runs on -- CPU/SoC temperature, undervoltage and throttling (Pi), disk and memory pressure -- and files what needs attention as Oracle signals.
name: pi_health

signals.description: The CPU/SoC temperature reached the manifest's temp_high_c tunable; the machine is overheating.
signals.name: board_overheating

signals.description: The board reports undervoltage or throttling, now or earlier this boot (from vcgencmd get_throttled).
signals.name: undervoltage_detected

signals.description: Disk usage on a watched mount reached the manifest's disk_high_pct tunable.
signals.name: disk_pressure

signals.description: Available memory fell under the manifest's mem_avail_low_pct tunable.
signals.name: memory_pressure
